mentions.note: winning races since transfer to Hereford; introduced by Bill Merryman
won his R.A.F. Group Championship; beat Len Marchant in an Inter-Station race at Hereford
won the Herts County Three Miles Race in 16 mins. 25 secs.

mentions.note: plucky effort in the Two Miles
raced in France, including round the Bois de Boulogne; third in another race against French runners
war-time friendship with Belgrave; his club Wirral A.C.
ran French cross-country races in Belgrave colours; second in Wirral A.C. 10 Miles Championship Cup on leave
running with French club A. S. Aulnay; ran in French Athletic Federation Invitation Race, Bois de Boulogne
old Belgrave member, entered for Cheshire
second claim member; member of Wirral A.C.
